module_title: The Twin Pillars of Inflation - WPI and CPI
introduction: At this beginner level, we will differentiate the two most crucial inflation indices in India: The Wholesale Price Index (WPI) and the Consumer Price Index (CPI). They measure prices at two entirely different stages of the supply chain.

core_concepts.title: WPI (Wholesale Price Index)
core_concepts.description: WPI measures the change in prices of goods sold in bulk at the 'wholesale level' (factory gate or mandi), before they reach the consumer. It is strictly used for business and trade analysis.

core_concepts.title: CPI (Consumer Price Index)
core_concepts.description: CPI measures the change in prices of goods and services at the 'retail level' (the final shop). This reflects the actual cost of living and the real inflation experienced by a common citizen.

core_concepts.title: The 'Services' Difference
core_concepts.description: This is the most critical difference: WPI only measures the prices of physical 'Goods'. It completely ignores services. CPI, on the other hand, measures both 'Goods AND Services' (like education, healthcare, transport, telecom).

core_concepts.title: Publishing Agencies and Base Years
core_concepts.description:
1. WPI is published by the Office of Economic Adviser (Ministry of Commerce and Industry). Base Year: 2011-12. 
2. CPI (Combined) is published by the National Statistical Office - NSO (Ministry of Statistics and Programme Implementation). Base Year: 2012.

important_entities.name: The Base Year
important_entities.significance: A Base Year is a normal, stable year chosen by the government to serve as a benchmark (Index = 100). If the WPI Base Year is 2011-12, it means we are comparing today's wholesale prices directly against the prices that existed in 2011-12.

trap_alerts_and_exceptions.explanation: A classic exam statement: 'WPI accurately captures the rising cost of internet and healthcare in India.' This is FALSE. WPI does not track services at all. Only CPI tracks the cost of services.

mnemonics_and_tricks.memory_phrase: WPI = Wholesale Goods, CPI = Citizen's Goods & Services
mnemonics_and_tricks.explanation: WPI is for the factories and traders. CPI is for the Citizens.

exam_strategy_tips: Memorize the publishing agencies perfectly. WPI = Ministry of Commerce (OEA). CPI = Ministry of Statistics (NSO). This is a highly repeated matching question.
